text: Assumption: E_OK confirms the acceptance of the command and the controller state change occurs asynchronously — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: E_OK confirms the acceptance of the command and the controller state change occurs asynchronously — is this correct?
norm: e_ok confirms the acceptance of the command and the controller state change occurs asynchronously
assumption: E_OK confirms the acceptance of the command and the controller state change occurs asynchronously.
rationale: The specification defines Sync/Async as 'Asynchronous' and E_OK as 'API call finished successfully', but mentions no synchronous blocks or confirmation callbacks in the payload.

original.text: Annahme: Asynchrone Ausführung bedeutet vermutlich, dass E_OK die Entgegennahme des Befehls bestätigt und die Controller-Zustandsänderung asynchron erfolgt — trifft das zu?
